slides.headline: the signs whose *january* changes the most, ranked
january is quiet. enjoy it before it isn't.
slides.body: mars sits in the part of your sky astrologers tie to rest. from jan 20, aquarius season reads as flirting. low stakes, good naps.

slides.headline: the sun sits across from you until jan 20.
slides.body: capricorn season reads as a mirror: what do the people close to you actually give back? notice, don't audit.

slides.headline: a first quarter moon in your sign on jan 15.
slides.body: saturn and neptune both sit in aries, and venus trines saturn the same day. make one promise you can keep.

slides.headline: the romance part of your sky goes into redo.
slides.body: mars turns retrograde in virgo on jan 10, in the part of your sky tied to romance. old flames may flicker. you don't have to relight them.

slides.headline: venus leaves your sign on jan 7.
slides.body: the spotlight moves on. a last quarter moon in scorpio on jan 29 reads as a clean ending. release, don't haunt.

slides.headline: venus opposes uranus in your sign on jan 9.
slides.body: read it as someone surprising you. mars retrograde squares your sign, so home plans get redone.

slides.headline: venus walks into your sign on jan 7.
slides.body: you'll read as magnetic and maybe too honest. ask someone out plainly. mars retrograde slows your work plans.

slides.headline: mars backs up right across from you.
slides.body: it turns retrograde in virgo on jan 10. partners slow down. read it as time to renegotiate, not run.

slides.headline: full moon in your sign on jan 22.
slides.body: jupiter is retrograde in leo all month too. read it as the month to be seen for what you actually want.

slides.headline: the new moon lands in your sign on jan 7.
slides.body: your season, your reset. astrologers read it as a personal new year. pick one plan and put a date on it.

slides.headline: mercury, the sun, then an eclipse.
slides.body: mercury arrives jan 13, the sun jan 20 and meets pluto there jan 25. an annular solar eclipse lands in aquarius on feb 6.

slides.headline: mars turns backwards in your sign.
slides.body: it stations at 10° virgo on jan 10 and stays retrograde into spring. read it as a slow, honest redo of how you push.

slides.headline: find your rank. *send it* to your #1.
slides.body: a reading, not a verdict. check back on jan 31.
